verses.text: Haxo yik ix yilan heb' chonhab' israel to ha winhaj Moisés chi' hanheja' max emxul-laj winh b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ha tikne'ik, ko gana to tza b'o juntzanhok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto ha winhaj Moisés, winh ix honh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, manh kojtakok tas ix ik'an winh, xchi heb' chonhab' chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb': --Ha tikne'ik, molb'ejekkot masanil k'e'en uchikin nab'a oro yik heb' ix heyetb'eyum yet' yik heb' heyuninal, heb' ix heyisil, tzeyik'ankot t'ayin, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ix yik'el yuchikin, ix yik'ankot heb' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix scha'anek' winh, ix yak'an ulax k'e'en winh t'a skal te' k'ak', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol jun smoldeal, ix b'o jun yechel jun kelem wakax. Ix ochnhej ijan winh swach' b'o'an jun yechel wakax chi'. Ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil: --Hex ketchonhab' israel, ha jun ko diosal tik ix honh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Aarón chi', ix sb'o'ank'e jun altar winh t'a yichanh jun yechel wakax chi', te cha'anh ix yal winh: --Ha k'ik'an skak'och junok niwan k'inh t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Haxo ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix smolb'an sb'a anima smasanil, ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojjab' heb', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e b'ulnaj heb' schanhalwi yet' sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh sdiosal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ixik, emanhxi yujto ha heb' ha chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, toxo ix sju'el sb'a heb'.

Yelxo wal t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a tas ix wala'. T'a elanhchamel ix sb'o jun yechel kelem wakax heb', syak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'ay. Syak'an silab' heb', syalan heb': Hex ketchonhab' israel, ha wal jun ko diosal tik ix honh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Toxo ix wila' to ha juntzanh anima tik, yelxo wal pit spensar heb'.
Ha tikne'ik manhxo hach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', skot wal wowal t'a juntzanh anima tik. Ol hin satel heb' smasanil, anhej het'ok ol hin b'o jun niwan nación yet' heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo winhaj Moisés chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan niwank'olal t'a Jehová sDiosal yuj heb' schonhab', ix yalan winh: --Mamin Jehová, ¿tas wal yuj skot yowal ha k'o'ol t'a yib'anh ha chonhab' to ha hach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' ipalil?

¿Tas wal yuj ol ha cha hach yal heb' aj Egipto chukal? Ol am yal heb' icha tik: Tob'an chuk spensar Dios t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yik'el heb' t'a tik, sb'at smilancham heb' t'a jolomtak witz, satji'el heb' yuj t'a sat lum lum tik, xcham heb'. Yuj chi' komonok max te kot yowal ha k'o'ol t'a yib'anh heb', mokab' ak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Komonok tza nakot heb' ha chekab', haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha loknak ha b'i ak'annak ha ti' t'a heb', alannak icha tik: Ol wik'cha'anh he b'isul yet' heyuninal. Lajan ol aj sb'isul heb' icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh. Hanheja' jun lum lum tik, toxo ix wala' to ol wak' t'a heyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xa chinak t'a heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sna'an Jehová to manhxo ol satel-laj schonhab' chi'.
Ix meltzajemta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz chi', yet'nakxo chab' pachanh k'e'en winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il yuj Jehová, t'a schab'il pak'anh k'e'en.
Ha wal Jehová ixb'o'an k'e'en k'e'en chi' schab'il, ix stz'ib'anoch letra chi' t'a k'e'en.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Josué yel yaw heb' anima, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha wal skab'an yel yaw heb' anima chi', icha wal to ayoch owal t'a yol campamento, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha juntzanh aw tz'och skab' chi', manh awok yik tzalajk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar junok owal, manh awokpax yik kusk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar anima yuj heb' ajk'o'ol, palta b'it tz'och swab'i, xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a slak'anil campamento chi', ix yilanoch jun yechel kelem wakax chi' winh, haxo heb' anima wan schanhalwi heb'. Ix te kot yowal winh, ix syumanel k'e'en k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi' winh, yuj chi' ix pojb'at k'e'en t'a yich witz chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at stzak'anelta jun yechel wakax chi' winh, ix syumanoch winh t'a skal k'ak'. Ixlajwi chi' ix smak'anpoj winh, chok'xonhej ix aji, ix yak'anem winh t'a skal ha ha', ix schekan winh yuk' heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': --¿Tas yuj hach montaj yuj juntzanh anima tik ix ha kuchb'an heb' sk'ulan jun niwan chukal tik? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Aarón chi': --Mamin, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, ojtak wal sik'lab'il to ha jun chonhab' tik, sgananhej heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' ix halan t'ayin: B'o junok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto ha winhaj Moisés ix honh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, ma chekel tas ix ik'an winh, max jaxlaj winh, xchi heb' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan t'a heb': Machtak hex ay k'e'en oro t'ayex, ma k'e'en uchikin, ik'ekeli, tzeyik'ankoti, xin chi t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'ayin, ix wak'an ulax t'a kal k'ak', haxo ix aji ix komon elta jun yechel wakax tik, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Moisés chi' to ha heb' anima chi', b'ekanxonhej sk'o'ol heb' yak'an k'ixwelal sb'a t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', haxo winhaj Aarón chi' maj skachoch wa'an jab'ok heb' winh.

Yuj wal chi' ix och tek'tek' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sti' campamento chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tikne'ik ha mach syal sk'o'ol syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, kotokab' t'a hin tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Masanil heb' yetlevita'il winh, ix snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a stz'ey winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax winh t'a heb': --Ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex to junjun hex tzeyik'b'at heyespada, tzex b'at t'a campamento, tzex ek' t'a kaltak mantiado, tze milancham heb' heyuktak, heb' heyamigo yet' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' winh levita ix yak' winh. Yuj chi', ay am oxe'ok mil anima ix smilcham heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tikne'ik ix heyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ina to ha hex ix he milcham heyuninal yet' heyuktak. Yuj wal chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heyib'anh, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' anima: --Te niwan he mul ix ochi. Ha tikne'ik tik tzin b'atxi t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová. Hata' ol hin lolon yet'ok, talaj ol yak' lajwok he mul chi' t'a heyib'anh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Wal yel Mamin, te niwan smul jun chonhab' tik ix och t'a ichanh, ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' oro yik syak'em sb'a heb' t'ay.

Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' lajwok smul heb' chi'. Tato max ak' niwank'olal smul heb' chi' jun, tza suksat hin b'i t'a yol ch'anh libro b'aj tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb' to ikxo yaji, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'och smul t'ayin, haton heb' chi' tzin suksat sb'i t'a yol ch'anh libro chi'.
Yuj chi' ixik, tzik'anb'at heb' chonhab' chi' t'a jun lugar ix wal t'ayach. Ha jun wángel ol b'ab'laj heyu'uj, palta ol k'och sk'uhal yik ol wak'anoch syahelal heb' anima tik yuj smul, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ha Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan ilya to smilwaj t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab' israel chi', yujto ix yak'och sb'a heb' sb'o'an jun yechel wakax, haton jun ix sb'o winhaj Aarón chi'.
